ns2:section.sectionText: SP25 CW 199: Undergraduate Open Seminar - The How of Where: Writing from Place - Amy Hassinger - “Story comes from place,” says Pulitzer-prize winning author Annie Proulx. Well, how, exactly? In this introductory writing workshop, we’ll set out to explore the answer to that question. Together, we’ll study a selection of evocative place-based fiction, teasing apart what makes the writing work, and then set out to write our own stories that come from and are bound up with place. Students will practice many of the basic elements of fiction writing through targeted writing exercises, story drafting, workshopping, and revision, all in the quest of learning to write place-based stories others will want to read. Restricted to Chancellor's Scholars in the Campus Honors Program (CHP). However, non-CHP students may petition to take the class. Go to https://honors.illinois.edu/curriculum/ and complete the form entitled "CHP Course Request Form for Non-CHP Students. Send the completed form to chp@illinois.edu
